title: berlandiera betonicifolia
intro: Berlandiera betonicifolia, commonly known as Desert Lavender, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. Desert Lavender's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, ease anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Berlandiera betonicifolia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
